candidates.description: Article-geometry selector over the current strongest XML skeleton / three-tier wordcode / typed-channel LZMA1 program. Adds a reversible topic-order page transform: encode pages in category/template/title order for model locality, then restore canonical page-id order on decode with a wrapper hash check.

article_geometry v2: stronger topic key. _PT now returns the alphabetically-sorted SET of all [[Category:X]] tokens in the page (vs v1's single first category). Falls back to first {{template}} or <title> when no categories. Normalization truncates at 240 chars (vs 120) for finer-grained sort. Selector picks min of raw vs reordered with 1B mode tag + 16B integrity hash for the ordered mode. Wraps lc4rmrl_z core

article_geometry v3: redirect-aware topic key. _PT first checks for #REDIRECT [[X]] and returns ~~Z~~+X to cluster all redirects by target (high-ASCII prefix puts redirects together at end of sort). Non-redirects: sorted set of [[Category:X]] tokens (v2). Falls back to first {{template}} or <title>. Wraps lc4rmrl_z core. Free-inverse via id-sort (no permutation stored).

article_geometry v4: redirect-aware (v3) plus title-suffix tiebreaker for non-redirect pages. _PT returns ~~Z~~+target for redirects; otherwise sorted-set of [[Category:X]] tokens followed by last 30 chars of title. Provides finer secondary ordering within a shared category set. Free-inverse via id-sort. Wraps lc4rmrl_z core.

article_geometry v5: v4 topic key (redirect-aware + sorted cats + last-30-char title-suffix) wrapped in sortfree-style minimal wrapper. compress picks min(raw, topic-ordered) bytes; decompress unconditionally id-sorts after lc4 decode. Saves 17B (mode tag + hash) per archive vs v4. Free-inverse via id-sort.

article_geometry v5 with AST-based annotation strip and ast.unparse normalization. Same compress/decompress logic; saves ~215B program size after lzma. Drops `from __future__ import annotations`, return/parameter type annotations, and AnnAssign type tags.
article_geometry_v5min with tier-3 wordcode cap raised from 4096 to 8192 after measured 10MB archive-body win.

article_geometry_v5min_wc8k with a revised free-inverse page ordering key: redirects by target, category pages grouped under an explicit category prefix with title-prefix tiebreaking, then infobox/template/title fallback. Keeps the typed XML channels, 8k tier-3 wordcode, typed id/timestamp/ip streams, and raw stdlib LZMA1 lc4/pb0 backend.
Article geometry with the original lc4rmrl_z archive manifest retained, but redundant inner decode checks removed from the counted decompressor.
Article geometry plus a score-smaller no-inner-hash variant of lc4rmrl_z. The benchmark roundtrip is the validation layer, so the inner archive omits size/hash fields.

Free-inverse article topic ordering before opcode_typed_anchor_ppm_o5_v1. Compression topic-sorts pages by redirect/category/title key, encodes the ordered stream with MediaWiki opcodes plus lean graph PPM; decompression restores canonical id order.

Native page-program codec slice: free-inverse shape/category/template page ordering, decoder-built page-shape memory, and a PAGE_SHAPE arithmetic event inside the receipt graph coder. Falls back to article_receipt_family_tree_v1 when complete archive selection rejects the page-program path.

article_typed_receipt_v1 plus an optional streaming self-referential page-family line/tree table before the semantic receipt graph coder. Topic-ordered pages define numeric skeletons as they pass; later matching tree lines can emit table refs plus values. The archive falls back to the base article receipt graph unless the family-table graph stream is smaller.

article_receipt_family_tree_v1 fallback plus an optional page-shape diff archive. Pages are free-inverse sorted by skeleton hash/category/template/title, then a decoder-built shape cache emits COPY_SHAPE plus slot patches or COPY_PRIOR_PAGE plus prefix/suffix tree patch events before the semantic receipt graph coder.

Score-smaller article-geometry wrapper over lc4rmrl_z. It selects raw or topic-ordered pages for the inner typed LZMA program, then always restores decoded complete pages by page id. This avoids storing a permutation, mode byte, or outer hash for enwik9's canonical page-id order.
Minified score-smaller article-geometry wrapper over lc4rmrl_z. It keeps the same free inverse page-id restoration as article_sortfree, with a smaller payload.
Regex-page-extraction variant of the score-smaller article-geometry wrapper over lc4rmrl_z.

Article geometry plus annotation-stripped, no-inner-check lc4rmrl_z payload. Removes runtime-irrelevant type annotations from the counted decompressor while preserving the winning topic-order archive.
Free-inverse article topic ordering with typed_receipt_v1 entity receipts plus normalized typed-anchor chain patch copies inside the same arithmetic event ledger.

Free-inverse article topic ordering wrapped around the typed_receipt_v1 semantic PPM architecture. Page order is derived from redirect/category/template/title keys already present in the data, then the ordered stream is encoded with opcode literals, geometric copies, typed-anchor chain copies, and decoder-built entity receipt references.
